description:
Title: New Application for Registering for an USI course

If you want to register for a course at the sports institute, you need to select a course.
If slots are free, the system tells you the courses, and dates.
Select one.
Next, you need to check if you already have an account at the sports institute.
If not, you need to check whether you are registered at an eligible university.
If you are, register your account.
If you are not, request an activation and wait for a response.
As soon as you have an account, log into it.
The application is also connected to your twitter account, and lets you tweet to friends who might want to join you, you can complete the registration for the course and provide the payment information.
In the end, you will receive a course ticket.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AccountExists</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckUniversity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_EligibleUniversity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TweetFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TweetMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select a course"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check whether an account exists"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountExists" name="Do you already have an account?" default="Flow_AccountNo"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckUniversity" name="Check registration at an eligible university"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" name="Are you registered at an eligible university?" default="Flow_UniversityNo"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveActivationResponse" name="Wait for an activation response" messageRef="Message_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountReadyMerge" name="Account paths merge"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log into the account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetChoice" name="Tweet to friends who might want to join?" default="Flow_TweetNo"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends who might want to join"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetMerge" name="Tweet paths merge"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation" name="Provide payment information"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCourseTicket" name="Receive course ticket" messageRef="Message_CourseTicket"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RegistrationComplete" name="Course ticket received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Listings" sourceRef="StartEvent_Registration" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCourseListings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Listings_Select" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCourseListings" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_CheckAccount" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccount_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReadyMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${accountExists}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Task_CheckUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckUniversity_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckUniversity" targetRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UniversityYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${eligibleUniversity}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UniversityNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterAccount_Merge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestActivation_Response" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActivationResponse_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMerge_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountReadyMerge" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_TweetChoice" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_TweetChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetChoice" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${tweetFriends}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetChoice" targetRef="Gateway_TweetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweet_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Gateway_TweetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetMerge_Complete" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetMerge" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complete_ProvidePayment" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_ReceiveTicket" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCourseTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveTicket_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCourseTicket" targetRef="EndEvent_RegistrationComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CourseRegistration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_USICourseRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SportsInstituteSystem" name="Sports institute system"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourseListings" name="Provide course listings" sourceRef="Participant_SportsInstituteSystem" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCourseListings" messageRef="Message_CourseListings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ActivationRequest" name="Activation request" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Participant_SportsInstituteSystem" messageRef="Message_ActivationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response" sourceRef="Participant_SportsInstituteSystem" targetRef="Task_ReceiveActivationResponse" messageRef="Message_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweet" name="Tweet to friends" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Participant_Twitter" messageRef="Message_Tweet"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourseTicket" name="Provide course ticket" sourceRef="Participant_SportsInstituteSystem" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCourseTicket" messageRef="Message_CourseTicket"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
